plain: Make your leftover cents useful: each time you pay with your card, the amount is rounded up and the extra is added to your savings.
alt: Let your loose change grow: we round up every card purchase and move the extra into your savings.
frame_flip: Stop letting your spare change go to waste: every card purchase rounds up so the difference lands in your savings instead of slipping away.
reordered: Your savings get the difference every time a card purchase rounds up, putting your spare change to work.
